create_AttrDict_class: create an AttrDict instance that allows accessing dictionary keys as attributes using dot notation
use_nested_attr_dict: use nested_attr_dict to recursively convert a nested dictionary into an AttrDict with dot-accessible keys
access_AttrDict_with_getattr: access an AttrDict value via dot notation by leveraging the __getattr__ method to return self[name]
set_AttrDict_with_setattr: set an AttrDict value via dot notation by leveraging the __setattr__ method to assign self[name] = value
convert_dict_to_AttrDict: convert a regular Python dict to an AttrDict so keys can be accessed and set using attribute syntax
